articles.title: Apple’s Screen Time updates are too little, too late
articles.summary: Apple spending a big chunk of its WWDC keynote on parental controls was surprising for several reasons. But the biggest is that, despite all the airtime, it didn't announce much new beyond a redesigned interface. Almost all the features touted already exist or are upgrades to current options. articles.title: Apple’s new parental controls are for keeping Apple out of trouble
articles.summary: When Apple put child safety front and center at WWDC on Monday, its stated goal was helping parents fine-tune their kids' online experiences and avoid excessive screen time.
